title: COLLECTIVE INVENTORIES
subtitle: A composite morning assembled from five people's practical work
lineage: Primary: SCION 065 (Five) · Supporting: SCION 084 (Pickpocket), SCION 092 (Hands of Bresson)
theorem: Make a composite morning from five situated source records. Give each one intact practical action before connecting them through washing, sweeping, preparing, carrying, and clearing away. Widen to reveal changed circumstances, preserve one unfinished task, and return to the first participant.
boundary_note: Explicitly identified as an editorial construction; shared action handoffs do not make the five historical recordings one documented day.

v1_defect_timecodes: Minor EDL timing offset (0.5s) between manifest and video opening slate fixed in v2.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: All five morning work actions, the unfinished lab task (`f5137eda`), and the return (`535e64d5`) are visually verified; only the manifest opening card duration offset (3.5s vs 3.0s) needed synchronization.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Manifest normalization assumed 3.5s opening slate while video used 3.0s.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Include exact `start_sec` and `end_sec` for all segments including the 3.0s Opening Slate directly in `manifest['edl']`, and clamp `535e64d5` return to `4.5s-10.5s` (`custom_window=True`).
